title: QuotaGroup
description: Defines a quota group for one or more snaps.

group-name.description: The name of the quota group.

subgroups.description: lists any subgroups this quota group contains.

parent.description: Contains the parent quota group name, if this group is a subgroup.

snaps.description: Lists any snaps that belong to this quota group.

services.description: Only for a subgroup, lists specific services belonging to a snap in the parent group.

constraints.description: The types and values of limits defined for this quota group.

cpu-set.description: Per-cpu limits, with cpus listing included cores.

threads.description: Maximum number of threads for this quota group.

journal.description: Number of messages logged per time period.

current.description: Contains the current usage of memory and task quotas
